title: Historical Real-World Evidence | Veterinary HBOC & Oxyglobin
description: Documented veterinary real-world cases, field use and historical evidence involving Oxyglobin, HBOCs and oxygen-delivery therapeutics in animals.
heading: Historical Real-World Evidence in Veterinary Oxygen Therapeutics.
lead: Documented clinical cases, field use, working-animal experience and historical records involving Oxyglobin, HBOCs and oxygen-delivery therapeutics. Each case is classified by source strength so a real-world story is not confused with controlled clinical evidence.

principle.heading: Real-world use is valuable evidence, but not all evidence is equal.
principle.text: This collection separates individual documented cases, regulatory field evidence, published clinical reports, operational or military use and historical company-reported experience. Source type and evidence boundaries remain explicit on every case page.

classes.label: Documented real-world case
classes.text: A named animal or clinical event supported by traceable documentary records.

classes.label: Regulatory field evidence
classes.text: Field data reviewed within a regulatory dossier, with population and endpoint boundaries stated.

classes.label: Published clinical case
classes.text: A peer-reviewed case report or clinical series with a citable publication record.

classes.label: Operational or military use
classes.text: Documented deployment or treatment experience in working-animal or field settings.

classes.label: Historical company-reported use
classes.text: Contemporaneous company documentation retained as a historical source and labelled as such.

firstCase.title: K-9 Saxon · Fresno Police · 2002
firstCase.text: A documented working-dog trauma case involving Oxyglobin, followed by an enduring institutional legacy in the Fresno Police Department's Saxon Award. The full case page will connect the contemporaneous Biopure record, the official Saxon Award policy and Oxyglobin regulatory context.
firstCase.status: Case file being assembled in this preview branch.

note: Historical Oxyglobin experience does not establish efficacy, safety, approval or endorsement for BHOC. This collection is designed to preserve documented precedent while keeping product, species, indication, source type and evidence level explicit.
